evidence.observation: Steady at about 8 ppm during ramp and early growth
Rose steadily 17.1 -> 22.9 -> 30.8 ppm from t=2760 to 3000 s, so air is getting in
Pressure rose from about 3.07 to 3.266 Torr while Ar held at 100 sccm, which fits extra gas leaking in
MFC reading matches setpoint, so the flow controller is not the cause
Thermocouple stable at 749.9 C with normal heater power

args.missing_evidence: No normal-run reference values yet. A leak-up (rate-of-rise) test with flow stopped, or checking the flange seals, would confirm a leak rather than an exhaust blockage. A blockage alone would not raise O2.
